registry_name: EEG Benchmark Registry — Motor Imagery Reference Collection

datasets.name: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database
datasets.description: 64-channel EEG recordings from 109 volunteers performing motor execution and imagery tasks (runs 4, 8, 12: left vs. right fist opening/closing).
datasets.license: ODC Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL)

datasets.name: OpenBMI Motor Imagery Dataset (Lee et al. 2019)
datasets.description: 62-channel EEG recordings from 54 healthy participants across two sessions (calibration and feedback) performing left- vs. right-hand motor imagery.

datasets.name: BCI Competition IV-2a (Tangermann et al. 2012)
datasets.description: 22-channel EEG recordings from 9 participants performing 4-class motor imagery (left hand, right hand, feet, tongue) across 2 sessions on separate days.

datasets.name: Cho et al. 2017 GigaScience BCI Dataset
datasets.description: 64-channel EEG recordings from 52 subjects performing left-hand and right-hand motor imagery alongside extensive physiological parameters.

datasets.name: MindLink-EEG / Yang et al. 2025
datasets.description: Large-scale continuous multi-paradigm EEG dataset with high-density cap configurations and comprehensive behavioral annotation.
